soldier: Head capsule yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, pilosity moderate. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.54–0.59, lateral margins nearly parallel, the middle or posterior part slightly narrowed, posterior margin largely straight. Frontal peaks raised but not high, slightly concave between them. Labrum sharply lanceolate, the apex shortly pointed, or shortly needle-shaped or nipple-shaped; apical setae long, subapical setae minute or slightly longer, lateral apical setae present or absent. Mandibles stout and long with the apex strongly curved; left mandible 0.52–0.62 times head capsule length and 0.95–1.06 times head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Widest part of the postmentum at the anterior sixth, anterior lateral margins nearly trapezoidal; waist region slender and long with parallel margins, waist constriction index 0.29–0.33. Pronotum kidney-shaped, anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave in the middle; 8–10 setae or slightly more in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
